_comment: Decisions on findings and recorded verdicts on tests. See README.md. A finding is known by its check and the matched content.

mastg-android-random-apis-insufficient-e.reason: Library code: the androidx ProfileInstaller picks a random delay before it installs a baseline profile. The value protects nothing.

detect-dangerous-android-permissions:e98.reason: The camera is needed to scan QR codes and to read the MRZ of an identity document.

mastg-android-backup-manifest-allow-back.reason: The value is false: backup is off.

mastg-android-hardcoded-security-provide.reason: The provider is AndroidKeyStore, which the rule itself names as the accepted exception.
The provider is AndroidKeyStore, which the rule itself names as the accepted exception.

mastg-android-asymmetric-key-pair-used-f.reason: A symmetric AES key for encryption and decryption (purposes 1 and 2), not an asymmetric key pair with mixed purposes.
An EC key pair with one purpose: signing (purpose 4).

yivi-android-exported-services:71a264303.reason: Library component of Google Play services, protected by a permission, as the match shows.

yivi-android-exported-receivers:2885dca0.reason: Library component of androidx, protected by the DUMP permission, which only the system and the shell hold.

yivi-android-native-stack-canaries:87528.reason: Compiled Dart code. The Dart compiler does not emit stack canaries; the OWASP test lists this as an expected false positive.

yivi-android-native-stack-canaries:cf714.reason: Compiled Go code. The Go compiler does not emit stack canaries; Go checks bounds at run time.

yivi-ios-stack-canaries:d9bada998c96.reason: Compiled Dart code. The Dart compiler does not emit stack canaries.

yivi-ios-arc:eca1148c2a25.reason: Compiled Dart code, without Objective-C or Swift code, so there is nothing for ARC to manage.

yivi-ios-arc:2fa438afdf3e.reason: A C library, without Objective-C or Swift code, so there is nothing for ARC to manage.

yivi-ios-arc:0002a2258e70.reason: A C library, without Objective-C or Swift code, so there is nothing for ARC to manage.

yivi-ios-general-pasteboard:b63efa2796a1.reason: The Flutter engine implements the clipboard channel with it. What the app copies is decided in the Dart code, which YIVI-TEST-0002 lists.

yivi-clipboard-writes:b24b598dc982.reason: The copy button of the NFC error details. It copies the logs without personal data; with "show sensitive data" ticked the button is off, which nfc_error_dialog_clipboard_test.dart tests.

yivi-webview-javascript-channels:5589be2.reason: The face capture WebView of the F-Droid app. The page can only send capture results over this channel, and the WebView only navigates within the host of the capture page over https, which face_capture_navigation_test.dart tests.
